label: Ecwid by Lightspeed
terms_note: Any Ecwid store owner creates a custom app (my.ecwid.com/#develop-apps) with the scopes it needs — read_catalog / update_catalog / create_catalog / read_orders / update_orders / create_orders / read_store_profile … — and receives a non-expiring secret token (no review); public App Market apps use OAuth 2 and Ecwid review; 600 requests / minute per token (429 + Retry-After; repeated abuse blocks the IP).

auth: 1. Tenant opens Ecwid admin › Apps › Develop Apps (my.ecwid.com/#develop-apps) and creates a custom app.
2. Sets the minimum scopes (docs recommend minimal permissions) — catalog + orders + webhooks.
3. Copies the secret token from the app's Details page; public token only for storefront reads.

fields.name: token
fields.help: Secret token of a custom app (Ecwid admin > Apps > Develop Apps > app Details; scopes read_catalog, create_catalog, update_catalog, read_orders, update_orders); non-expiring, sent as `Authorization: Bearer secret_...`.

config_fields.name: store_id
config_fields.help: Ecwid store id (shown in the admin footer / URL); every call goes to https://app.ecwid.com/api/v3/{store_id}/...

me.note: GET /api/v3/{storeId}/profile returns the store profile {generalInfo{storeId, storeUrl}, account{accountName, accountEmail}, settings{storeName}, formatsAndUnits{currency}, ...}.

create_listing.note: POST /api/v3/{storeId}/products {name, sku, price (required by Ecwid), quantity, description} (scope create_catalog) returns {id}. `currency` is the store's (formatsAndUnits), and images go through a separate upload endpoint, so `currency`/`image_urls` are ignored.

update_listing.note: PUT /api/v3/{storeId}/products/{productId} with the given fields (name, price, description, quantity); returns {updateCount}.

end_listing.note: PUT /api/v3/{storeId}/products/{productId} {enabled: false} takes the product off the storefront (documented boolean; reversible with enabled=true) and returns {updateCount}. DELETE /products/{id} (permanent) is not used.

set_inventory.note: PUT /api/v3/{storeId}/products/{productId} {quantity} sets the absolute stock (PUT .../products/{id}/inventory takes a quantityDelta instead). `listing_id` (product id) is required; `sku` alone is not accepted (lookup by sku is a second call).

list_orders.note: GET /api/v3/{storeId}/orders?offset&limit(max 100)&createdFrom(UNIX timestamp or 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS')&fulfillmentStatus(AWAITING_PROCESSING|PROCESSING|SHIPPED|DELIVERED|...). Returns {total, count, offset, limit, items[{id, orderNumber, total, paymentStatus, fulfillmentStatus, createDate, trackingNumber}]}; `status` is the fulfillmentStatus and there is no per-order currency field.

mark_shipped.note: PUT /api/v3/{storeId}/orders/{orderId} {fulfillmentStatus: SHIPPED, trackingNumber, shippingOption: {shippingCarrierName}} (scope update_orders) returns {updateCount}.

not_offered.listing_metrics: No analytics endpoint in the Ecwid REST API (no product views / conversions); only order data is exposed.
